description.value: Angry Otter Liquor is the retail liquor brand of Otter Co-op, a locally-owned cooperative with locations across the Fraser Valley and BC Interior. The Highwayman branch serves the Chilliwack area and offers a range of beer, wine, and spirits. For touring cyclists passing through Chilliwack, it is a convenient stop to pick up supplies.
